prediction_text: Direction: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election — this is the call of the one panel astrologer singled out on the card. Specific claims: (1) The astrologer who, when 17 Republicans still contested the nomination, picked Trump to become the Republican nominee follows through and names Trump to win the presidency itself. (2) Trump defeats Hillary Clinton on 8 November 2016 despite Clinton leading most polls — an upset victory, against the panel/polling consensus. Timing: election day, 8 November 2016 (day scale).
basis:
Card face carries no tradition/system field; system actually used: Western mundane/electional astrology (method western-astro chapter).
Card-given data only: October 2016, same Costa Mesa panel context; the card's distinguishing fact is that one panellist had already called Trump's nomination correctly against a 17-candidate field — an established against-consensus track record on this exact subject. Reading: the question is anchored to that astrologer's forecast (the card supplies no other distinguishing subject); a reader who read Trump's rise correctly at the nomination stage, against the field, is read as holding the same line at the general-election stage rather than reverting to the polling favourite. No charts or quotes are given on the card, so the astrologer is not named and no margin detail is asserted; confidence reduced accordingly.
